comments.author: @morenogregori3301
comments.text:
I First met this show only one year ago. I was having dinner with my parents and decided to put the first episode on Amazon Prime (such an error). I was so embarrassed and switched to something else.

I thought it was too much of everything. Too strong, too violence, too many bad words, too drugs. 

So, I turned back to the same old zapping over many shows, never finding one I truly appreciate. 
I know most people can understand: you simply have too much choice on streaming platforms. You end up starting series and never finish them, over and over in an endless loop.

It was two months ago that I decided to give this show another chance, just because it was on the top rated list on Prime video. 
Well, I found out it's a fascinating portrait of life, it's simply stunning and amazing how it describes situations that can happen to anyone. 
It's hilarious and made me cry at the same time, on countless occasions. 

Gave me, an Eu citizen which has never been to US, a full portrait of society and humanity that moves people to do what they do. 

This series is pure gold and art, it's quickly becoming my favorite show of all times. 
Do yourself a favor and give it a try!
